At the {wiki:Festival of Initiates} on the Isle of Destiny, four instructors let you try out each vocation's fighting style: sword and shield with {npc:Neill}, staff with {npc:Tylius}, spears with {npc:Shanoya}, and runes and spells with {npc:Salbra}. You test everything on {creature:Party Skeleton|Party Skeletons}, and at the end you choose your vocation.
None: it is the introduction to the Isle of Destiny, with no minimum level or Premium.
Training spells {spell:Practise Fire Wave} and {spell:Practise Healing} (temporary)
The sword, spears, runes and spells from the festival are for training only: they disappear when you get close to {npc:Captain Kurt}.
Once you leave through the fence to the north you cannot go back to the festival.
Talk to {npc:Neill}. He gives you the {item:Mean Knight Sword} and the {item:Studded Shield}. Kill a few {creature:Party Skeleton|Party Skeletons} to try out melee combat.
Mean Knight Sword and Studded Shield
You can talk to {npc:Willem} and {npc:Ula}, but it is not required.
Talk to {npc:Tylius} and receive the {item:Sorc and Druid Staff}. Try it out on the {creature:Party Skeleton|Party Skeletons} inside his tent.
Walk **east** and open the chest to get 3 {item:Meat}. If you like, talk to {npc:Willow (NPC)|Willow}.

Keep going **east** to {npc:Shanoya} and talk to her. Then take 3 {item:Mean Paladin Spear|Mean Paladin Spears} from the chest in her tent and try to kill a few {creature:Party Skeleton|Party Skeletons} with them.
Head to {npc:Salbra} and talk to her. She teaches you the {spell:Practise Fire Wave} spell.
Talk to Salbra again and say {key:proceed}. You receive 10 {item:Lightest Magic Missile Rune|Lightest Magic Missile Runes}: try them out on the {creature:Party Skeleton|Party Skeletons}.
Say {key:proceed} once more. Salbra teaches you {spell:Practise Healing} and takes 85 hit points from you so you can test the healing spell. Take the {item:Mana Potion} from the chest behind her.

Leave Salbra's tent to the **east**. The message *"Congratulations, initiate! Go to a vocation trainer and choose your destiny!"* appears. When you walk **north** and pass the fence, the quest is completed.
Once you pass the fence you cannot go back to the festival.

When you get close to {npc:Captain Kurt} you lose the {item:Mean Knight Sword}, the {item:Mean Paladin Spear|Mean Paladin Spears}, the {item:Lightest Magic Missile Rune|Lightest Magic Missile Runes} and the training spells. This message appears: *"Your Festival items just miraculously disappeared! In the distance, you hear Tylius chuckle."*

After you choose your vocation, go to {npc:Captain Kurt}'s boat in the **north** of the {wiki:Isle of Destiny} (1 floor above ground). Talk to him to be taken to one of the accessible ports on the mainland.
Captain Kurt will not let you leave the island with more than 1000 gp on your character. Deposit the rest at the bank first (you can do it with {npc:Raffael}, nearby).

After you choose your vocation and set off for the mainland on {npc:Captain Kurt}'s boat, open the chest on the boat to get a bag with an {item:Adventurer's Stone} and a {item:Paper (Adventurer's Guild)|Paper}.
When you reach the mainland the quest log gets 5 updates ({wiki:Loose Ends} is added), but oddly Child of Destiny still does not show up as completed.
